spec.description: FinancialServicesBacktestResultSpec defines the desired state of FinancialServicesBacktestResult

backtestPeriods.description: The number of consecutive months to conduct backtesting for, ending with the last full month prior to the end_time according to the dataset's timezone.

datasetRef.description: Required. The Dataset to backtest on.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed FinancialServicesDataset resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectNumID}}/locations/{{location}}/instances/{{instanceID}}/datasets/{{datasetID}}".

name.description: The name of a FinancialServicesDataset resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a FinancialServicesDataset resource.

endTime.description: Required. End_time specifies the latest time from which labels are used and from which data is used to generate features for backtesting.  End_time should be no later than the end of the date_range of the primary dataset.

modelRef.description: Required. The Model to use or to backtest.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed FinancialServicesModel resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectNumID}}/locations/{{location}}/instances/{{instanceID}}/models/{{modelID}}".

name.description: The name of a FinancialServicesModel resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a FinancialServicesModel resource.

parentRef.description: The FinancialServicesInstance this FinancialServicesBacktestResult is created under.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed FinancialServicesInstance resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/locations/{{location}}/instances/{{instance}}".

name.description: The name of a FinancialServicesInstance resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a FinancialServicesInstance resource.

performanceTarget.description: Required. PerformanceTarget gives information on how the test will be evaluated.

partyInvestigationsPerPeriodHint.description: Required. A number that gives the tuner a hint on the number of parties from this data that will be investigated per period (monthly). This is used to control how the model is evaluated. For example, when trying AML AI for the first time, we recommend setting this to the number of parties investigated in an average month, based on alerts from your existing automated alerting system.

resourceID.description: The FinancialServicesBacktestResult name. If not given, the metadata.name will be used.
